profile_text.body:
Sketch is a for-profit design software company founded in 2010 and headquartered in The Hague, Netherlands. Its flagship product is a macOS-native design editor that the company describes as built around focused tools, an intuitive interface, and an infinite canvas, with stated support for designing, prototyping, collaborating, and handing off work to developers. The company describes itself as independent and says it makes its own decisions on matters including privacy and pricing.

Sketch offers an AI-capable tier of its tool, listed in the image and graphic design category as Sketch AI, which the company notes includes a local processing option and handles EU design data. The product remains macOS-native in its editor form, with collaboration and web-based access available for team workflows.

The site's held facts include one registered MCP server, listed under the name app.roughsketch/roughsketch, which is described as enabling users to search, read, preview, create, update, rename, arrange, and trash sketches in Google Drive. No litigation or SEC filings are recorded for the company.
